question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Fondness
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 (Liking)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Fondness"** refers to a great liking or affection for someone or something. (पसंद या स्नेह)

 
 
• **Example:** She has a fondness for classical music and often attends concerts.
 
 
 
• **"Liking"** refers to a preference or affection for something or someone. (पसंद)
 
 
• **Example:** His liking for spicy food is evident from his daily meals.
 
 
 
• Hence, it is clear that the most appropriate synonym of "Fondness" is "Liking".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 (Liking)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2 (Mistake)** (गलती): An act or judgment that is wrong or incorrect.

 
 
• **Example:** It was a mistake to leave the door unlocked while going out.
 
 
 
• **Option 3 (Brilliance)** (प्रतिभा): Exceptional talent or intelligence.
 
 
• **Example:** The brilliance of her performance left everyone in awe.
 
 
 
• **Option 4 (Dislike)** (नापसंद): A feeling of aversion or distaste for something or someone.
 
 
• **Example:** He has a strong dislike for dishonesty and lies.
